desc:
Welcome to CHOP AND STEAL AN EGG!

How to Play:

🪓 Chop trees to find hidden eggs!
🥚 Steal the eggs and run back to your base!
⚙️ Shred your eggs for Luck and hatch rare pets!
🏃 Get faster on your treadmill to unlock new areas!
💰 Collect cash from your pets & buy better axes!

❤️ Join the Group and like the game for rewards!
